x: Charlie Smart went first for our "A" team and up against Palmer, the Southern champion, he ran extremely well to hand over about 30 yards behind the leader.

Len Marchant set a fast pace from the start and quickly gained a 30 yds. lead, which was not lost until the beginning of the second lap when Bill Lucas with Gorton and Palmer, of Cambridge, in close attendance, took up the running.

This was our second track fixture and took place on April 29th at Tooting Track, as a triangular match between Hercules A.C., Mitcham A.C., and ourselves. There were events for both Seniors and Juniors, and in the latter we had Adams 4th and Palmer 6th in the 220, Frank Wright 1st, and J.
Palmer 49th, were not backed up well enough to bring us in to the picture. Palmer was recovering from an attack of flu otherwise he would have probably done better.

Not content with this he took us up two more places and finished 9th only just outside the Club best ever. Colin Collis on that difficult switchback leg through Redhill, ran a great stage in a time beaten only by Palmer of St.
